label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee/community gathering honoring the mayor's forty years of service, at the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, with eight lanterns and a target of 200 fresh loaves. The mayor knew and approved the hospitality gathering, but its jubilee purpose and surprise details were withheld; he suspected the anniversary without confirmation. Baker knowingly supplied hospitality bread, neighbour kept the committee surprise confidential and contributed bread, and secretary arranged reservation/escort while allowing hospitality details to remain a surprise; baker's and secretary's knowledge of the specific jubilee purpose is not established.
